verdict.rationale: Community reports show a usable free tier, but it is capped ('free for a limited number of notes'). The docs name Business and Enterprise plans, yet nothing in the pack shows tier prices or a feature comparison, and Enterprise capabilities like HIPAA route through sales. missing for 10: published per-tier pricing, a documented comparison of what each paid tier adds, first-party confirmation of the free tier and its limits, and evidence that basic paid tiers are self-serve without sales contact.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start free and see exactly what each paid tier costs and adds — no "talk to sales" wall for basic use

citations.quote: Granola is only free for a limited number of notes.
Workspace admins on Business and Enterprise plans can also create workspace API keys.
